items.title: AnyDesk Pre-auth Heap Buffer Overflow RCE
items.summary: Classification: Critical, Solution: Official Fix, Exploit Maturity: Proof-of-Concept, CVSSv3.1: 9.8, CVEs: , Summary: AnyDesk before 8.0.3 allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via a heap-based buffer overflow, as demonstrated on Linux for command execution as root without the victim approving desktop control. In the stream packet handler for mode 5 in the session protocol, a payload length value is not validated.

items.title: Critical vulnerabilities in NIVIDA
items.summary: Classification: Severe, Solution: Official Fix, Exploit Maturity: Not Defined, CVSSv3.1: 10.0, CVEs: CVE-2026-65180, CVE-2026-65173, CVE-2026-65172, CVE-2026-65170, CVE-2026-65164, CVE-2026-65162, CVE-2026-65161, CVE-2026-65131, CVE-2026-65110, CVE-2026-65104, CVE-2026-65103, CVE-2026-65101, CVE-2026-67456, CVE-2026-65150, CVE-2026-65149, CVE-2026-65148, CVE-2026-65147, CVE-2026-65141, Summary: CVE-2026-65180 7.8 - NVIDIA Megatron-LM contains a vulnerability in checkpoint loading where an Attacker may cause an RCE by convincing a user to load a maliciously crafted file. A successful exploit of this vulnerability may lead to code execution, escalation of privileges, information disclosure, and data tampering. CVE-2026-65173 9.1 - NVIDIA AIStore for Linux contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the token-revocation endpoint where an unauthenticated remote attacker may submit crafted token-revocation lists. A successful exploit may lead to data tampering and denial of service. CVE-2026-65172 8.6 - NVIDIA AIStore for Linux and Kubernetes contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the ETL management API where an unauthenticated remote attacker may access ETL information or control existing ETL jobs by sending crafted GET or POST requests to an AIStore proxy. A successful exploit may lead to information disclosure and unauthorized start or stop operations that affect the integrity and availability of ETL data-processing pipelines. CVE-2026-65170 8.6 - NVIDIA AIStore for Linux contains a vulnerability in the experimental HT backend where an unauthenticated remote attacker may cause server-side request forgery by supplying a crafted original URL. A successful exploit of this vulnerability may lead to information disclosure. CVE-2026-65164 8.1 - NVIDIA AIStore for Linux contains a path traversal vulnerability in the dSort archive extraction component where a remote attacker may cause an improper limitation of a pathname to a restricted directory by supplying crafted archive member names to a dSort job. A successful exploit may lead to arbitrary file creation or overwrite, code execution, information disclosure, data tampering, and denial of service. CVE-2026-65162 10.0 - NVIDIA AIStore for Linux contains a vulnerability in the legacy ETL Kubernetes PodSpec initialization API where a remote attacker may supply Kubernetes host-namespace and container-security settings. A successful exploit may lead to code execution, privilege escalation, information disclosure, data tampering, and denial of service. CVE-2026-65161 7.5 - NVIDIA AIStore for Linux contains a vulnerability in the Promote API where an unauthenticated remote attacker may read files accessible to the target process by supplying a crafted absolute source path. A successful exploit may lead to information disclosure. CVE-2026-65131 6.0 - NVIDIA NVSentinel for Linux contains a vulnerability in the platform-connectors component, where the gRPC health-event interface, exposed over a world-writable Unix domain socket, lacks authentication. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to denial of service. CVE-2026-65110 7.8 - NVIDIA Megatron-LM contains a vulnerability in checkpoint loading where, an attacker could cause an RCE by convincing a user to load a maliciously crafted file. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to code execution, escalation of privileges, information disclosure, and data tampering. CVE-2026-65104 7.1 - NVIDIA Megatron-LM for all platforms contains a vulnerability in inference, where an attacker could cause hash collisions in the cache used for inference requests. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to data tampering and partial information disclosure. CVE-2026-65103 8.1 - NVIDIA AIStore for Linux contains a path traversal vulnerability in the target-side object rename handler, where an unauthenticated remote attacker could cause an improper limitation of a pathname to a restricted directory by submitting a crafted rename destination directly to an AIStore target, resulting in the arbitrary creation or overwrite of a file. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to code execution, escalation of privileges, information disclosure, data tampering, and denial of service. CVE-2026-65101 8.6 - NVIDIA AIStore for Linux contains a vulnerability in the distributed sort component where an attacker could cause server-side request forgery by supplying a crafted external key map URL. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to information disclosure. CVE-2026-67456 4.4 - NVIDIA Warp contains a vulnerability where an attacker could cause a heap-based buffer overflow. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to denial of service. CVE-2026-65150 7.3 - NVIDIA DALI contains a vulnerability where an attacker could cause an uncontrolled out-of-bounds read. A successful exploit of this vulnerability mighty lead to information disclosure, data tampering, and denial of service. CVE-2026-65149 7.3 - NVIDIA DALI contains a vulnerability where an attacker could cause an uncontrolled out-of-bounds write. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to denial of service, information disclosure, and data tampering. CVE-2026-65148 7.3 - NVIDIA DALI contains a vulnerability where an attacker could cause a stack-based buffer overflow. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to code execution, information disclosure, data tampering, and denial of service. CVE-2026-65147 7.3 - NVIDIA DALI contains a vulnerability where an attacker could cause an uncontrolled out-of-bounds read. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to information disclosure and denial of service. CVE-2026-65141 7.8 - NVIDIA Isaac Lab contains a vulnerability where an attacker could cause an eval injection. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to code execution, information disclosure, data tampering, and denial of service.

items.title: Ivanti Connect Secure -tuotteissa haavoittuvuutta käytetty hyväksi
items.summary: Classification: Critical, Solution: Official Fix, Exploit Maturity: Functional, CVSSv3.1: 8.6, CVEs: CVE-2026-104935, Summary: Haavoittuvuus koskee Ivanti Connect Secure -tuotteeseen versioita 22.8R2.4 ja sitä vanhempia 22.8-haaran versioita sekä versioita 25.1.1.1 ja 25.1.2.2 ja vanhempia versioita kyseisissä ohjelmistohaaroissa. Ivantin mukaan versio 22.7R2.14 ja sitä vanhemmat 22.7-haaran versiot eivät ole haavoittuvia. Ivantin mukaan haavoittuvuus ei koske versiota 22.7R2.14 eikä sitä vanhempia 22.7-haaran versioita. Ivanti on vahvistanut, että haavoittuvuutta on käytetty hyväksi. Volexityn tutkimissa tapauksissa hyökkääjä käytti sitä osana haavoittuvuusketjua, jonka avulla hyökkääjä sai laitteeseen pääkäyttäjän oikeudet. Hyökkääjä etsi organisaation tunnuksia ja pyrki peittämään jälkensä. See also: https://kyberturvallisuuskeskus.fi/fi/haavoittuvuudet/haavoittuvuus-2026-35, See also: https://www.volexity.com/blog/2026/10/13/a-series-of-unauthenticated-events-chained-exploitation-of-ivanti-connect-secure-zero-days/

items.title: Remote Code Execution (RCE) vulnerability identified in the OpenText™ EnCase SAFE Agents
items.summary: Classification: Critical, Solution: Official Fix, Exploit Maturity: Unproven, CVSSv4.0: 9.3, CVEs: CVE-2026-75120, Summary: Products affected The OpenText™ EnCase SAFE Agents component for Windows, Mac, Linux, AIX, and Solaris, which are used by the products listed below, may be vulnerable to unauthenticated remote code execution. - OpenText™ Endpoint Investigator 26.1 and earlier - OpenText™ Endpoint Forensics & Response 26.1 and earlier - OpenText™ Information Assurance 26.1 and earlier - OpenText™ Endpoint Security 24.1 and earlier Immediate action recommended OpenText strongly recommends that each client that currently uses the affected products with the SAFE Agent components apply their respective patch (described below) as soon as possible and redeploy all agents, where Check-In Agents are not configured to automatically upgrade via the SAFE.
items.summary_html:
Classification: Critical, Solution: Official Fix, Exploit Maturity: Unproven, CVSSv4.0: 9.3, CVEs: CVE-2026-75120, Summary: Products affected
The OpenText™ EnCase SAFE Agents component for Windows, Mac, Linux, AIX, and Solaris, which are used by the products listed below, may be vulnerable to unauthenticated remote code execution.  

- OpenText™ Endpoint Investigator 26.1 and earlier
- OpenText™ Endpoint Forensics & Response 26.1 and earlier
- OpenText™ Information Assurance 26.1 and earlier
- OpenText™ Endpoint Security 24.1 and earlier

Immediate action recommended

items.title: UK AI Safety Institute Warns of Risks in Unreleased Models
items.summary: The United Kingdom's AI Security Institute believes frontier AI models pose risks before they're released to the public, and it doubled down on the need for voluntary safety commitments from AI companies. U.K. AISI said in a blog post that continued improvements in AI models changed the landscape for model evaluations. First, safety risks come up much earlier in the development lifecycle, and second, current testing practices cannot keep pace. The institute said part of the problem is that previous evaluation processes focused on making models safe for public release. The U.K. AISI said that to bring evaluations closer to where they need to be, knowledge transfer should occur is needed between frontier labs, national safety institutions like itself and the American Center for Advancing Innovation and Standards for Super Intelligence (renamed from the Center for AI Standards and Innovation) and other companies in critical industries. U.K. AISI said international standards organizations can facilitate this collaboration.

items.title: LG Smart TVs Vulnerable to Pre-Auth Root Takeover From Local Network
items.summary: Three vulnerabilities in LG's webOS can be chained to give an attacker on the same local network root access to certain smart TVs without a PIN or any interaction from the owner. LG has issued a fix, according to an advisory published by SSD Secure Disclosure on October 12. The chain was tested on two TV models, the 32LQ636BPSA and the 27TQ600SW, running webOS 7.5.7-25 on firmware 04.54.40. Whether other models or firmware versions are affected is not known. Owners of affected TVs should check for a firmware update. No workaround is available for those who cannot update yet. The attack enters through a service that the TV exposes on port 3001, which is used by the LG ThinQ app for pairing. An attacker replays a manifest from sync-demo, a built-in app already on the device, signed with a test certificate the firmware trusts. A permission in the manifest causes the pairing service to skip the PIN prompt and hand over a privileged key.

items.title: GitHub Tightens npm Publishing After Flaw Left 1,500+ Packages Vulnerable to Hijacking
items.summary: GitHub has taken the step of expiring unvalidated npm trusted publishing configurations 48 hours after creation after researchers found that it was possible for an attacker to push new versions of a different user's package without having to steal their credentials. The change contains the risk associated with trusting a repository or project name that changes ownership, GitHub said, adding npm also rejects trusted publishing tokens from GitHub Actions issue_comment events going forward, along with the Existing pull_request_target restriction. In an update to its documentation, GitHub states that a newly created trusted publisher configuration must complete its first successful publish within two days, which validates the configuration and binds it to the "repository's immutable identity." The technique, referred to as Extension Resurrection, can be weaponized to hijack extensions already referenced inside these trusted bundles just by claiming a namespace left unclaimed. As many as 87 packs in Open VSX and 677 packs in the VS Code Marketplace were flagged as vulnerable. "Attackers could claim those empty slots, publish malicious code under them, and have it installed automatically alongside the trusted pack – silently pushing updates to anyone who installed the pack previously," Myers noted at the time. "Because extensions run with full host access, this effectively amounts to [remote code execution] delivered under the guise of legitimacy."

items.title: '123456' password linked to Denmark data breach affecting 8.8M people
items.summary: A person claiming responsibility for the breach of Denmark's Central Register of Persons (CPR) says they gained access through an IT company's account protected by the password "123456." The person told Danish news outlet Politiken they had no intention of selling or leaking the data. The newspaper reported that at least three company accounts, including an administrator account, used the same password. Denmark's CPR administration confirmed a breach affecting the information belonging to 8.8 million people on October 5, adding that a Danish company's legal access to the CPR system was abused. According to documents obtained by broadcaster TV 2, the attacker gained access to the CPR system on September 10 and ran the 14 million automated searches between then and September 20. The intrusion was detected on October 2, 12 days after the last reported searches.

items.title: Docker Hub flaw let attackers impersonate users, tamper with images
items.summary: Docker has disclosed a critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-105445) in Docker Hub that let attackers access another user’s container repositories using a personal access token (PAT). Docker Hub is an online registry for storing, sharing, and downloading container images - templates that package everything needed for an application to run in an isolated environment. According to a security bulletin from the Docker team, an attacker could create an account and PAT, then convert the account into an organization and name a target user as its owner. The CVE-2026-105445 flaw stems from Docker Hub reassigning a personal access token (PAT) to a designated organization owner without changing its secret or obtaining the target's consent. This allowed the attacker to use the token to authenticate as the target. Affected users and organization owners were notified on October 2, and transferred PATs were deactivated on October 8, except for those whose owners explicitly requested to retain them. Docker says users who didn’t receive a notification should assume they were not impacted and did not need to take any action.

items.title: Ghostscript flaw lets hackers hijack servers via PDF uploads
items.summary: A critical heap buffer overflow vulnerability (CVE-2026-39919) in the Ghostscript interpreter and rendering engine could allow remote code execution through specially crafted PDF files. The flaw was discovered on August 23 by researchers at Defiant's platform Wordfence using their Argus AI-powered system. Ghostscript is a PostScript and PDF interpreter that can render PDFs as images, generate thumbnails for previews, and optimize PDF files by compressing embedded images and removing unnecessary font data. When generating a PDF thumbnail, WordPress can use the PHP Imagick extension to call ImageMagick, which launches Ghostscript. A specially crafted PDF file containing a JPEG 2000 image can trigger incorrect handling of low-bit-depth samples and mismatched component resolutions. WordPress administrators need to ensure, through their hosting provider, that Ghostscript has been upgraded to version 10.08.0 or later. If using Docker, it is recommended to rebuild and redeploy with an updated, patched base image. If unable to upgrade to a fixed Ghostscript release, it is recommended to block PDF uploads to the server or disable PDF rendering in ImageMagick. Wordfence said it has not seen any in-the-wild exploitation of CVE-2026-39919 yet.

items.title: A Series of Unauthenticated Events: Chained Exploitation of Ivanti Connect Secure Zero-Days
items.summary: In the first week of October 2026, Volexity discovered an unknown threat actor, UTA0576, abusing a zero-day exploit chain to compromise a fully patched (at the time, version 22.8R2.4) Ivanti Connect Secure (ICS) VPN appliance. This exploit chain combined an authentication bypass, a remote code execution (RCE), and a privilege escalation vulnerability to achieve unauthenticated root-level code execution. The RCE and authentication bypass vulnerabilities are tracked under CVE-2026-104935. Volexity identified a range of post-exploitation actions undertaken by the threat actor that targeted Active Directory credentials and secrets, including Local Administrator Password Solution (LAPS) passwords and BitLocker recovery keys. Volexity began working closely with Ivanti as soon as it suspected a vulnerability chain. Since UTA0576 deleted evidence of exploitation from Ivanti debug logs and Linux audit logs, forensic analysis was necessary to discover how the ICS VPN appliance had been compromised. Volexity worked with Ivanti to collect memory and disk images of the impacted device along with analyzing core dumps that were generated as a result of exploitation. Volexity leveraged the core dumps and system memory collections with Volexity Volcano to identify and reconstruct the full exploit chain used by the threat actor. UTA0576 also passed commands and results through the exploit chain’s HTTPS requests rather than a separate command-and-control (C2) channel, with no backdoor or web shell deployed to the compromised device.

items.title: Ivanti warns of Connect Secure zero-day exploited in attacks
items.summary: Ivanti urged customers on Tuesday to immediately patch an actively exploited zero-day vulnerability in the Ivanti Connect Secure (ICS) remote access gateway. Formerly known as Pulse Connect Secure and originally Juniper Pulse, the enterprise-grade ICS SSL VPN provides remote employees, contractors, and hybrid workforces with secure access to corporate and cloud resources. Tracked as CVE-2026-104935, this high-severity authentication bypass zero-day affects ICS versions 22.8R2.4 and earlier, 25.1.2.2 and earlier, and 25.1.1.1 and earlier. Cybersecurity firm Volexity, which found and reported the flaw, revealed earlier today that a previously unknown threat actor it tracks as UTA0576 has chained the CVE-2026-104935 vulnerability since at least October 3 with two other flaws to achieve unauthenticated root-level code execution on fully patched devices. "Notably, UTA0576 deployed no malware or web shell. Instead, the threat actor re-exploited the device for every command it ran and tampered with logs to cover its tracks, evading Ivanti’s Integrity Checker Tool," Volexity said. While Ivanti has patched two flaws, it is still working to address a privilege escalation vulnerability that UTA0576 exploited as part of the same chain. Threat intelligence company Defused also confirmed Volexity's report, saying that it caught the first signs of CVE-2026-104935 exploitation in the wild starting October 1.

Formerly known as Pulse Connect Secure and originally Juniper Pulse, the enterprise-grade ICS SSL VPN provides remote employees, contractors, and hybrid workforces with secure access to corporate and cloud resources.

Tracked as CVE-2026-104935, this high-severity authentication bypass zero-day affects ICS versions 22.8R2.4 and earlier, 25.1.2.2 and earlier, and 25.1.1.1 and earlier.

Cybersecurity firm Volexity, which found and reported the flaw, revealed earlier today that a previously unknown threat actor it tracks as UTA0576 has chained the CVE-2026-104935 vulnerability since at least October 3 with two other flaws to achieve unauthenticated root-level code execution on fully patched devices.

"Notably, UTA0576 deployed no malware or web shell. Instead, the threat actor re-exploited the device for every command it ran and tampered with logs to cover its tracks, evading Ivanti’s Integrity Checker Tool," Volexity said.

While Ivanti has patched two flaws, it is still working to address a privilege escalation vulnerability that UTA0576 exploited as part of the same chain.

Threat intelligence company Defused also confirmed Volexity's report, saying that it caught the first signs of CVE-2026-104935 exploitation in the wild starting October 1.

items.title: Videopuhelu­huijaus leviää nyt – älä usko, jos saat tällaisen puhelun
items.summary: Viime viikon aikana ihmiset menettivät Kaakkois-Suomen poliisilaitoksen alueella yli 80 000 euroa erilaisissa puhelinhuijauksissa, tiedottaa Kaakkois-Suomen poliisi. Poliisin mukaan huijarit hyödyntävät ajankohtaisia ilmiöitä sekä ihmisten tunteita ja luontaista käyttäytymistä. Huijarit vetoavat esimerkiksi pelkoon, hätään, kiireeseen, auttamisen haluun tai rikastumisen toiveeseen. Huijarit lähestyvät uhrejaan usein esiintyen luotettavan viranomaisen, kuten poliisin, verottajan tai pankin edustajana. Huijarin yhteydenotto voi saapua puheluna, videopuheluna, tekstiviestillä tai sähköpostilla. Se voi tulla näennäisesti luotettavista numeroista tai osoitteista, minkä vuoksi huijauksen tunnistaminen voi olla vaikeaa, poliisi varoittaa.
